data.title: 山田杏奈 · 雨停前的小小收获
data.description: 雨中的商店檐下，杏奈穿黄色雨衣和牛仔背带长裤，弯膝蹲下把滑出购物袋的苹果拾回来。收起的黑伞靠在墙边；她用衣袖边轻轻擦掉苹果上的水珠，望见它完好无损便开心地笑了。
data.action: 蹲下拾回苹果，擦去水珠后松一口气地笑。
data.promptProse: Anna Yamada crouches under the shop eaves to retrieve an apple that slipped from her shopping bag, wiping its droplets gently with her sleeve. Her yellow rain jacket covers a striped shirt and full-length denim overalls above rubber boots. The folded black umbrella leans against the wall behind. Diffuse rainy daylight in the medium view lights the intact apple and cheerful face, with wet paving reflections and soft shelter shadows beneath her knees.
